title: Reading Practice Test 15 – Transportation & City Life
description: Đề luyện Reading theo cấu trúc đề thi TOEIC (IIG Việt Nam), rút gọn 28 câu: Part 5 (10) · Part 6 (4, có câu điền cả câu) · Part 7 (14: bảng giá gửi xe, thông báo giá vé, bài báo có chèn câu, lịch tàu và e-mail). Chủ đề: giao thông công cộng, đô thị, đi lại công tác.

questions.content: The city plans to ------- the subway line to the airport by 2027.
questions.explanation: 'plan to + V nguyên mẫu' → 'extend' (kéo dài, mở rộng).

questions.content: Commuters are ------- to use public transportation during the bridge repairs.
questions.explanation: Bị động 'be urged to V' = được kêu gọi làm gì.

questions.content: Traffic on Highway 5 was ------- heavy this morning because of an accident.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho tính từ 'heavy' → 'unusually heavy' (đông bất thường).

questions.content: The ferry departs ------- hour from Pier 3, starting at 6:00 A.M.
questions.explanation: 'every hour' = mỗi giờ một chuyến. 'each of' phải đi với 'the + danh từ số nhiều'.

questions.content: The parking garage is closed for repairs, so drivers should use the lot ------- the street.
questions.explanation: 'across the street' = bên kia đường.

questions.content: Bicycle-sharing stations ------- throughout the downtown area last year.
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ là vật (trạm xe đạp) được lắp đặt, thời gian 'last year' → bị động quá khứ 'were installed'.

questions.content: The mayor's proposal to reduce traffic ------- widespread support from residents.
questions.explanation: Câu cần động từ chính cho chủ ngữ 'The mayor's proposal' → 'received'.

questions.content: Train tickets are ------- cheaper when purchased at least a week in advance.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho tính từ so sánh 'cheaper' → 'generally' (nhìn chung).

questions.content: Drivers ------- exceed the speed limit will be fined.
questions.explanation: Đại từ quan hệ chỉ người làm chủ ngữ cho 'exceed' → 'who'.

questions.content: The new subway cars are quieter and more ------- than the old ones.
questions.explanation: Song song với tính từ 'quieter' → 'more comfortable'. 'comforting' = an ủi – sai nghĩa.

groups.passage:
City of Westbrook – Public Notice

Main Street between 5th and 9th Avenues will be closed to vehicles from June 2 to June 30 ---131--- the city replaces water pipes beneath the road.

During the closure, drivers are advised to use Oak Street as an alternate route. Local businesses on Main Street will remain open, and sidewalks will be ---132--- to pedestrians at all times. ---133---.

Bus routes 12 and 15 will also be temporarily ---134---. Updated schedules are available on the city's transportation Web site.

We thank residents for their patience.

questions.explanation: Theo sau là mệnh đề (the city replaces…) → liên từ 'while' (trong khi). 'during/because of/despite' + danh từ.
Sau 'will be' cần tính từ: 'accessible to pedestrians' = người đi bộ vẫn đi lại được.

options.B: Free parking will be available in the lot behind City Hall.
options.C: Water rates will rise next year.
options.D: The mayor will retire in May.

questions.explanation: Đoạn nói về ảnh hưởng tới người dân và cửa hàng khi đóng đường → câu chèn hợp lý: có bãi đỗ xe miễn phí.
Bị động 'will be (temporarily) + V3' – các tuyến xe buýt bị đổi lộ trình → 'rerouted'.

groups.passage:
Central Station Parking Garage
Monthly permits now available!

• Standard permit – $120/month: Park at any time in any available space
• Evening & weekend permit – $60/month: Valid on weekdays after 5:00 P.M. and all day Saturday and Sunday

Permits can be purchased at the garage office on Level 1 or online at centralparking.com. Electric vehicle charging stations are located on Level 3.

questions.content: What is the main difference between the two permits?

options.B: The size of the parking spaces
options.C: The hours during which they are valid

questions.explanation: Vé Standard đỗ mọi lúc; vé Evening & weekend chỉ dùng sau 5 giờ chiều ngày thường và cuối tuần → khác nhau ở thời gian sử dụng.

questions.content: What is available on Level 3?
questions.explanation: 'Electric vehicle charging stations are located on Level 3.' Văn phòng ở tầng 1.

groups.passage:
Metro Transit Authority
Notice of Fare Changes

Beginning March 1, the standard bus and subway fare will increase from $2.50 to $2.75. This is the first fare increase in six years and will help pay for new, energy-efficient buses and improved station lighting.

Riders who use the Metro Card will continue to receive a 10% discount on every trip. Monthly passes will increase from $90 to $95. Seniors and students will still pay half price.

To learn more, visit metrotransit.gov or pick up a brochure at any station.

questions.content: Why is the fare increasing?

options.A: To pay for a new stadium
options.B: To help pay for new vehicles and lighting

questions.explanation: '…will help pay for new, energy-efficient buses and improved station lighting.'

questions.content: How long has it been since the last fare increase?
questions.explanation: 'This is the first fare increase in six years.'

questions.content: What will NOT change on March 1?

options.C: The discount for Metro Card users

questions.explanation: 'Riders who use the Metro Card will continue to receive a 10% discount' → giữ nguyên. Các mục khác đều tăng.

groups.passage:
Car-Free Sunday a Success

LAKEVIEW – For the first time, the city of Lakeview closed its downtown streets to cars last Sunday. [1] Instead of traffic, residents found street musicians, food stalls, and games for children. Organizers estimate that more than 25,000 people took part.

Local businesses reported a strong day. [2] "We had twice as many customers as on a normal Sunday," said Rita Gomez, owner of a bakery on Lake Avenue.

Not everyone was pleased, however. Some residents complained that they had difficulty reaching their homes. [3] City officials said they would review these concerns before deciding whether to make Car-Free Sunday a monthly event. [4]

questions.content: What is the article mainly about?

options.B: A music festival in a park
options.D: A day when downtown streets were closed to cars

questions.explanation: Bài báo về ngày Chủ nhật không ô tô ở trung tâm Lakeview.

questions.content: What did Ms. Gomez say about the event?

options.A: Her business was busier than usual.
options.B: It should be held every week.

questions.explanation: 'We had twice as many customers as on a normal Sunday.'

questions.content: The word "strong" in paragraph 2, line 1, is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: 'a strong day' (về kinh doanh) = một ngày thành công, buôn bán tốt → successful.

questions.content:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"Delivery drivers also had to change their usual routes."
questions.explanation: 'also' nối tiếp một bất tiện khác sau câu cư dân khó về nhà → vị trí [3].

groups.passage:
Coastline Rail – Weekday Schedule: Harbor City to Pinewood

Train 301 – Departs 6:15 A.M. – Arrives 7:40 A.M. – Express
Train 305 – Departs 7:00 A.M. – Arrives 8:50 A.M. – Local; café car
Train 309 – Departs 8:10 A.M. – Arrives 9:35 A.M. – Express; Wi-Fi
Train 313 – Departs 9:30 A.M. – Arrives 11:20 A.M. – Local

Weekday tickets: $28 one way. Tickets purchased at the station on the day of travel cost $5 more.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

To: Jin Park
From: Alice Moreno
Date: April 3
Subject: Pinewood meeting

Hi Jin,

Our meeting with the Pinewood city planners has been confirmed for Thursday, April 10, at 10:00 A.M. at their office, which is a 10-minute walk from Pinewood Station.

Since you'll want to review the proposal on the way, I suggest taking a train with Wi-Fi. Please buy your ticket online in advance so that the company doesn't have to pay the extra station fee. You can submit your receipt for reimbursement afterward.

Let me know if you have any questions.

Alice

questions.content: According to the schedule, what is true about Train 305?
questions.explanation: Tàu 305: 'Local; café car' → có toa bán đồ ăn uống.

questions.content: What is the purpose of the e-mail?

options.B: To provide information about a meeting

questions.explanation: E-mail xác nhận thời gian, địa điểm cuộc họp và hướng dẫn đi lại.

questions.content: Which train will Mr. Park most likely take?
questions.explanation: Cần tàu có Wi-Fi và tới kịp cuộc họp 10:00 (đi bộ 10 phút) → Train 309 (có Wi-Fi, tới 9:35).

questions.content: How much will Mr. Park's ticket most likely cost?
questions.explanation: Mua trực tuyến trước (không bị phụ phí $5 tại ga) → giá vé ngày thường $28.

questions.content: What is Mr. Park asked to do after the trip?
questions.explanation: 'You can submit your receipt for reimbursement afterward.'
